MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming devices felt relevant because my Raspberry Pi, NES-style case, and HDMI cable suggest an interest in connecting entertainment equipment to a TV.",
    "The Fire TV Stick 4K stood out as a convenient streaming option alongside my Raspberry Pi projects, with included TV controls giving me a concrete reason to choose it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers do not solve a current need for me. Buying headphones and a headphone mount does not mean I want voice-controlled audio around the house.",
    "The Echo displays and smart plug assume I want video calling or home automation, but my recent purchases give me no specific reason to add either.",
    "Several streamers fit the same possible need, but I would choose only one; interest in the 4K Stick does not give me a reason to buy the other versions."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Kindle and Amazon Basics purchases seem to have been taken as a broader interest in Amazon devices, although I chose those items for specific practical uses.",
    "My interest in connected electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in an Alexa household, which is a different goal from setting up computers and TV equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Ethernet adapter, network cables, cable organizers, and cleaning equipment point toward improving connectivity and maintaining a working setup.",
    "My purchases often support equipment I already have, such as a Raspberry Pi case or headphone mount; compatibility and a clear supporting purpose matter to me.",
    "My latest purchases emphasize wired networking, desk organization, and equipment care, which feel more immediate than starting a smart-home setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You partly recognized my interest in TV-connected projects, but interpreted my practical electronics purchases too broadly as a desire for Alexa devices."
}
